issues.legal_issue: The civil court’s jurisdiction is not excluded by Section 34 of the SARFAESI Act over claims seeking declarations that a sale deed and mortgage deed executed before the secured creditor’s enforcement action are invalid, because the DRT cannot determine those claims.

Under the unamended Section 17(3) of the SARFAESI Act, the DRT may restore possession to a borrower or a person claiming through the borrower, but cannot hand possession to an independent claimant who was not in possession when the secured creditor took possession.
A plaint cannot be rejected in part under Order VII Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure; it must be rejected as a whole or not at all.
